types.observe: the git commits API returns the commit, and the branch ref points at it or at a descendant
types.absence: the git refs API answers 404 for the branch that carried the commit

failures.cause: the GitHub API rate-limited the call or answered a server error
the GitHub App installation lacks the permission the call needs
the branch ref moved while the commit was pushed
the branch is protected against direct pushes

types.observe: the repos API returns the repository with its visibility and settings
types.absence: the repos API answers 404 for the repository, or returns it archived when archive_on_destroy is set

failures.cause: the GitHub API rate-limited the call or answered a server error
the GitHub App installation lacks the permission the call needs
the repository name is taken in the organisation

types.observe: GET /firewalls/{id} returns the firewall with its rules and the resources it applies to

failures.cause: the Hetzner Cloud API rate-limited the call or answered a server error
the project's Hetzner Cloud API token is invalid or lacks write access
delete is refused while the firewall is still applied to a resource
a firewall of the name exists in the project

outputs.name: publicIpByLocation
outputs.meaning: The public IPv4 address of the cluster's public load balancer in each location it runs in, each serving the cluster's apps on ports 80 and 443.
outputs.shape: JSON object mapping each location name, fsn1, nbg1 or hel1, to an IPv4 address

outputs.name: clusterRepoUrl
outputs.meaning: The web address of the private repository Argo CD syncs the app's cluster from.

outputs.name: subscriptionId
outputs.meaning: The id of the subscription that created the cluster.

outputs.name: issuerBucket
outputs.meaning: The name of the bucket that hosts the cluster's service-account issuer.
outputs.shape: S3 bucket name, mitstack-oidc- and 26 lowercase base32 characters

outputs.name: enrolmentTokenSha256
outputs.meaning: The SHA-256 digest of the token the cluster's node presents to enrol with the platform; the token itself is never published.

outputs.name: openbaoSealKey
outputs.meaning: The OpenBao seal key of a cluster that hosts the platform, as an armored PGP message to the key openbaoSealKeyRecipient names; the key itself is never published.

outputs.name: sealedSecretsKey
outputs.meaning: The Sealed Secrets private key of a cluster that hosts the platform, as an armored PGP message to the key openbaoSealKeyRecipient names; the key itself is never published.

outputs.name: openbaoInit
outputs.meaning: The root token and recovery key from OpenBao's first init on a cluster that hosts the platform, each as an armored PGP message to the key openbaoSealKeyRecipient names.
outputs.shape: ASCII-armored OpenPGP messages, one per secret

inputs.name: hostsPlatform
inputs.label: Hosts the mitstack platform
inputs.description: Set to true only for mitstack's own cluster, which then boots OpenBao, External Secrets and Traefik without the platform and takes Argo CD's token from a GitHub App. It takes effect only at install.

inputs.name: openbaoSealKeyRecipient
inputs.label: OpenBao seal key recipient
inputs.description: With hostsPlatform, the ASCII-armored OpenPGP public key, as gpg --armor --export prints it, that the block encrypts the OpenBao seal key to.

inputs.name: githubAppId
inputs.label: GitHub App ID
inputs.description: With hostsPlatform, the App ID of the GitHub App whose key in OpenBao mints Argo CD's repository token.

inputs.name: githubAppInstallationId
inputs.label: GitHub App installation ID
inputs.description: With hostsPlatform, the id of that App's installation on the organisation.

types.observe: the Kubernetes API at apiEndpoint answers /readyz with ok to the cluster credential, and every node reports Ready
types.absence: GET /servers/{id}, /load_balancers/{id}, /firewalls/{id}, /networks/{id} and /images/{id} answer 404 for every server, load balancer, firewall, network and snapshot the cluster's subscription created

failures.cause: the Hetzner Cloud API rate-limited the call or answered a server error
the project's Hetzner Cloud API token is invalid or lacks write access
the location has no capacity for the server type
Kubernetes has not yet reported every node Ready
the project's server limit is reached

a load balancer of the name exists in the project

inputs.name: location
inputs.label: Hetzner location
inputs.description: The Hetzner location the host runs in, fsn1, nbg1 or hel1. These are Hetzner's locations in the EU, so the app's data stays there, and they share one network zone, so servers in different locations can sync data over a private network. The server, its primary IP and its volume all live in this one location.

inputs.name: serverType
inputs.label: Server type
inputs.description: The Hetzner server type. It has no default, because blocks that create a server want different sizes, and each block refuses a type it does not run on.

types.observe: GET /servers/{id} returns the server with status running
